# Plan file location

When creating or updating a planning document in agent plan mode, always place it under [docs/plans](../../docs/plans).

## Required behavior

- Create new planning documents in [docs/plans](../../docs/plans).
- Use lowercase kebab-case file names for plan documents.
- Keep the plan content in English, consistent with the repository documentation language rules.
- If a plan already exists for the same topic, update it in place instead of creating a duplicate.

## Expected location

- New plan: [docs/plans](../../docs/plans)
- Example: [docs/plans/application-development-plan.md](../../docs/plans/application-development-plan.prompt.md)
